name: What happens first when I hire a painter for a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: What happens first when I hire a painter for a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first step is a quick on-site assessment so the painter can see the condition of the walls, trim, ceilings, and exterior surfaces. For foreclosed homes, that visit is important because missing fixtures, water damage, peeling paint, and leftover debris can change the scope fast.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with an inspection. A site visit helps define prep needs, damage repair, and the full painting scope before work begins.
